title: Confirm native and JBMC corpus conformance on the final cache support
description: Run the two established proof-tier conformance suites against original JVM observations after symbolic boxed-long cache handling and opt-in ordinary startup witness search. The selected default native conformance binary remains covered by the inline test run.

steps.name: Run both proof-tier conformance suites
steps.run: JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run --only rust --tier proof --test conformance --test-threads 2
